title: Grateful Dead Live at West Palm Beach Auditorium on 1982-09-11
source: 10th Row Center; Nakamichi CM-300 > Sony TC-D5 > MC > DAT; DAT(c) @ 44.1 kHz > Tascam DA-20MKII > Canare Coax > Korg MR-2000S > Kimber USB 2.0 > Samplitude Pro X2 (Build 256) > TLH v2.7.0 (align on sector boundaries, flac 8, ffp) > Foobar2000 v1.3.10 Live Show Tagger; Transfer & edits by Jeff Mitchell

ai_review.summary: Audience recording captures a fine fall‑tour show with pleasant sound.
ai_review.review: The concert is praised as one of the best shows from the 1982 fall tour, and reviewers note that the audience recording delivers nice, clear sound. While no specific songs are highlighted, the overall performance receives a solid four‑star rating.

ai_rating.rationale: Single 4‑star review cites strong show and decent audio; limited data yields low confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Nice sound noted; no significant issues mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Generally strong performance, considered one of the fall tour's best by the reviewer.
